New York: An Atlanta jeweler just bought its way into the Washington, DC market — and said it's a template for more.

Solomon Brothers Jewelers has acquired Mervis Diamond Importers, the independent DC-area retailer with three showrooms. Mervis keeps its name, staff and showrooms; co-founders Ronnie and Zed Mervis stay on.

"Succession is the quiet crisis in our industry," said Solomon Brothers president Jaron Solomon.
